summary: Aegis provides a framework-free, revision-safe profile lifecycle with identities and credential bindings; the server includes a JDBC-backed integration surface.

origin.authority: Snapshot only; referenced live source and tests are authoritative and may have changed after this record.

evidence.note: Implements profile creation, lifecycle changes, identity linking, credential binding, and compare-and-set mutation.
Covers revision conflicts, terminal revocation, identity-binding integrity, and secret-safe profile values.
Resolves exactly one active local profile after the external issuer and subject are verified.
